The Windows x64 package now includes picotool 2.3.1; firmware inspection, signing and flashing work after extraction. You can still choose another picotool executable. Linux and macOS users can [build from source](https://github.com/XiaoNetwork-Astral/pico-forge-all/blob/v0.10.1/docs/Building.md).

---

Windows x64 便携包现已内置 picotool 2.3.1，解压后即可检查、签名和刷写固件；仍可手动选择其他 picotool 可执行文件；Linux 和 macOS 用户可[从源码构建](https://github.com/XiaoNetwork-Astral/pico-forge-all/blob/v0.10.1/docs/Building.md)
